Small TFT-like residual model (GRU+attention+gate) on champion residual. Best blend w=0.20 gives only +2.0/day vs anchor with unchanged loss days; below promotion threshold, rejected.
Low-weight holiday blend into current champion; closest to safety line but Jan-Feb-like does not improve, all_5fold -38.5/day, test-like -29.9/day, p90 regret worsens; rejected, no submit.
5% weekly-relative blend into current champion; tiny Jan-Feb-like lift is offset by broad/test-like loss; rejected, no submit.

Window-level GRU predicts 89 rolling 2-hour average prices and dispatches directly by maximizing discharge_window_score - charge_window_score over legal pairs. Corrected direct-window evaluation is closest deep model so far but still -184.1/day vs champion, loss days +1; rejected standalone, useful as rerank/ensemble candidate.
Shallow tree variants max_depth 3/4/5 all underperform current champion on all_5fold and Jan-Feb-like; reject standalone shallow regularization
GRU centered target learns daily price minus daily mean. Better than GRU absolute on loss days, but still -448.0/day vs current champion; rejected as standalone.
Small non-causal TCN direct price model. Shape metric improves over GRU absolute but profit remains -503.5/day vs champion; rejected.
TCN centered target. Worse than GRU centered and -597.9/day vs champion; centered target does not transfer well to TCN.

Small GRU direct 96-point price prediction using official next-day forecast features plus bid_space/business/time features; no champion residual. CPU AutoDL run. Underperforms current champion by -630.3/day and adds +5 loss days, so rejected as submit candidate but kept as deep-learning baseline.
Small TFT-like direct price model. Underperforms champion by -719.1/day and adds +5 loss days; rejected.
Window TFT-like predicts 89 rolling 2-hour averages. Lowest window RMSE among window deep variants but profit -853.1/day vs champion and +5 loss days; rejected.
TFT-like centered target with GRU+attention+gate. Worse than GRU centered and -855.1/day vs champion; higher capacity overfits/noisy for centered shape.
GRU z-score target removes daily mean and amplitude. It worsens profit (-861.0/day vs champion), suggesting amplitude information is still useful; rejected.
Window TCN predicts 89 rolling 2-hour averages. Window RMSE improves but dispatch profit worsens to -963.6/day vs champion; confirms lower window RMSE does not imply correct extreme pair ranking.
Centered target ensemble underperforms champion in every fold; loss days increase 5->11 and Jan-Feb-like drops by 1057.7/day, rejected.
